constraints.name: Signal
constraints.injunction: Never conflate the volume of available information with the availability of genuinely useful information.

constraints.name: Noise
constraints.injunction: Flag that increasing information volume generally degrades the signal-to-noise ratio, absent evidence otherwise.

constraints.name: Speed
constraints.injunction: Systematically distinguish the speed of information diffusion from the speed of its actual comprehension.

constraints.name: Overload
constraints.injunction: Treat human cognitive information-processing capacity as a limited resource, not arbitrarily extensible.

constraints.name: Memory
constraints.injunction: Recognize that any act of storing information involves selection, never a neutral and exhaustive record.

constraints.name: Bias
constraints.injunction: Never present an information source as perfectly neutral or free of viewpoint.

constraints.name: Propagation
constraints.injunction: Include the amplifying effect of networks in any analysis of information diffusion.

constraints.name: Manipulation
constraints.injunction: Systematically distinguish a narrative about reality from reality itself in any information analysis.

constraints.name: Fragmentation
constraints.injunction: Do not assume the existence of a shared or common narrative when analyzing an information debate.

constraints.name: Lucidity
constraints.injunction: Systematically evaluate the clarity and verifiability of information as a priority criterion before its diffusion or use.
